• Schedule: Full Time

• Recruiter name: Natalia Dzieglo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sta modellando il profilo di rischio di un'impresa di assicurazione globale appello a voi? Ti piace trasformare complesse intuizioni di rischio in azioni pratiche che influenzano le decisioni strategiche?

In qualità di Senior P&C Risk Manager, si agirà come partner commerciale di rischio affidabile per la leadership aziendale, fornendo intuizioni di rischio indipendenti, sfida e consigli in una delle più grandi aziende di Zurigo. Collaborando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder senior di Gruppo Risk Management e team di business, vi aiuterà a guidare miglioramenti significativi nelle pratiche di gestione del rischio, rafforzare la governance, promuovere il processo decisionale informato e sostenere i risultati migliori per i nostri clienti.

La vostra esperienza ci aiuterà a sfidare e affinare il nostro appetito di rischio, fornire consigli di rischio indipendenti e sostenere iniziative chiave in tutto il portafoglio P&C. Lavorando con gli stakeholder senior, sarete abilitati ad influenzare le decisioni, migliorare i framework di rischio e contribuire a un'organizzazione più forte e resiliente. A Zurigo, ci preoccupiamo di permettervi di crescere – sarete incoraggiati a sviluppare le vostre competenze, condividere le vostre intuizioni e svolgere un ruolo chiave nella modellazione del nostro futuro.

Cosa farai

• Fornire consigli di rischio, orientamento e sfida indipendenti ai principali stakeholder sulle principali attività, progetti e decisioni aziendali in tutto il portafoglio P&C.

• Guidare e supervisionare analisi e valutazioni dei rischi, tra cui immersioni profonde e valutazioni dei rischi per i grandi progetti; rivedere e sfidare le risposte ai rischi; fornire intuizioni di rischio attuabili alla gestione senior.

• Sviluppare e migliorare la governance dei rischi, tra cui politiche, metodologie, strumenti e modelli, garantendo un'adozione coerente in tutta l'organizzazione P&C.

• Superare le attività di assicurazione, monitoraggio e reporting, convalidare i risultati chiave e traducerli in chiare informazioni per la gestione senior.

• Sostenere la leadership di Risk Management sulle priorità strategiche, discussioni esecutive e questioni di rischio chiave.

• Promuovere una forte cultura del rischio attraverso la consegna di formazione e impegno degli stakeholder.

Cosa porti

• 12+ anni di esperienza all'interno di P&C Commercial Insurance o Retail, preferibilmente in una funzione aziendale come Underwriting o Claims, o nella gestione del rischio.

• Laurea o equivalente qualifica/esperienza nella gestione del rischio, assicurazione, scienze attuariali, finanza, economia, amministrazione aziendale o disciplina correlata. La certificazione di sottoscrittore professionale è un vantaggio.

• Comprensione avanzata del business dell'assicurazione P&C, compresi i driver di rischio chiave attraverso la sottoscrizione, la conservazione, i reclami, i prezzi, l'esposizione alla catastrofe, la riassicurazione, il rischio operativo e il rischio strategico.

• Esperienza di lavoro in una funzione di gestione del rischio di seconda linea, o esperienza equivalente che fornisce la revisione indipendente, la sfida e il supporto consultivo per gli stakeholder aziendali.

• Prove capacità di interpretare le informazioni sul rischio, identificare i temi chiave e tradurre i risultati in chiare raccomandazioni e azioni di gestione.

• Ottima comunicazione, pensiero critico, collaborazione e capacità di esecuzione, con un track record di coinvolgimento con gli stakeholder senior e influenzare il processo decisionale in una complessa organizzazione di matrice.

• Esperienza leader o sostenere valutazioni di rischio, recensioni dell'appetito di rischio, attività di assicurazione, processi di governance e reporting di gestione.

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.

Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.

Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.

Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!

Informazioni sulle agenzie di reclutamento

Zurigo non accetta domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Rifiutiamo qualsiasi responsabilità per le applicazioni non richieste, così come eventuali commissioni associate.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che sa che ogni dipendente è unico - questo è ciò che rende il nostro team così grande!
Unisciti a noi mentre esploriamo costantemente nuovi modi per proteggere i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

• Posizione(i): CH - Zürich

• Funzionamento remoto:

• Orari: Tempo pieno

• Nome del reclutatore: Natalia Dzieglo

Zieht die Gestaltung des Risikoprofils eines globalen Versicherungsgeschäfts Sie an? Haben Sie Spaß daran, komplexe Risikoerkenntnisse in praktische Maßnahmen umzusetzen, die strategische Entscheidungen beeinflussen?

Als Senior P&C Risk Manager treten Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Risiko-Geschäftspartner für Unternehmensführung auf und bieten unabhängige Risikoinformationen, Herausforderungen und Beratung in einem der größten Unternehmen von Zürich. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Stakeholdern in allen Gruppenrisikomanagement- und Geschäftsteams tragen Sie dazu bei, sinnvolle Verbesserungen der Risikomanagementpraktiken voranzutreiben, die Governance zu stärken, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und bessere Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu unterstützen.

Ihre Expertise wird uns helfen, unsere Risikobereitschaft herauszufordern und zu verfeinern, unabhängige Risikoberatung anzubieten und wichtige Initiativen im gesamten P&C-Portfolio zu unterstützen. In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Stakeholdern können Sie Entscheidungen beeinflussen, Risikorahmen verbessern und zu einer stärkeren und widerstandsfähigeren Organisation beitragen. Bei Zurich ist es uns wichtig, dass Sie wachsen – Sie werden ermutigt, Ihre Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, Ihre Erkenntnisse zu teilen und eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung unserer Zukunft zu spielen.

Was du tun wirst

• Bereitstellung unabhängiger Risikoberatung, -beratung und -herausforderung für wichtige Stakeholder bei wichtigen Aktivitäten, Projekten und Geschäftsentscheidungen im gesamten P&C-Portfolio.

• Leitung und Beaufsichtigung von Risikoanalysen und -bewertungen, einschließlich Risikotiefstabgängen und Risikobewertungen für Großprojekte; Überprüfung und Infragestellung von Risikoreaktionen; Bereitstellung umsetzbarer Risikoeinblicke für die Geschäftsleitung.

• Entwicklung und Verbesserung der Risiko-Governance, einschließlich Richtlinien, Methoden, Tools und Vorlagen, um eine einheitliche Einführung in der gesamten P&C-Organisation zu gewährleisten.

• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Assurance-, Monitoring- und Reporting-Aktivitäten, validieren Sie die wichtigsten Ergebnisse und übersetzen Sie sie in klare Erkenntnisse für die Geschäftsleitung.

• Unterstützen Sie die Risikomanagement-Führung bei strategischen Prioritäten, Führungskräftediskussionen und wichtigen Risikofragen.

• Förderung einer starken Risikokultur durch Schulung und Stakeholder-Engagement.

Was du mitbringst

• 12+ Jahre Erfahrung in P&C Commercial Insurance oder Retail, vorzugsweise in einer Geschäftsfunktion wie Underwriting oder Claims oder im Risikomanagement.

• Grad oder gleichwertige Qualifikation / Erfahrung in Risikomanagement, Versicherung, Versicherungswesen, Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Eine professionelle Underwriter-Zertifizierung ist von Vorteil.

• Fortgeschrittenes Verständnis des P&C-Versicherungsgeschäfts, einschließlich der wichtigsten Risikotreiber für Zeichnung, Reservierung, Forderungen, Preisgestaltung, Katastrophenrisiko, Rückversicherung, operationelles Risiko und strategisches Risiko.

• Erfahrung in einer Second-Line-Risikomanagement-Funktion oder gleichwertige Erfahrung mit unabhängiger Überprüfung, Herausforderung und beratender Unterstützung für Geschäftsbeteiligte.

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Risikoinformationen zu interpretieren, Schlüsselthemen zu identifizieren und Ergebnisse in klare Empfehlungen und Managementmaßnahmen umzusetzen.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation, kritisches Denken, Zusammenarbeit und Ausführungsfähigkeiten, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Interaktion mit leitenden Stakeholdern und der Beeinflussung der Entscheidungsfindung in einer komplexen Matrixorganisation.

• Erfahrung in führenden oder unterstützenden Risikobewertungen, Risikobewertungen, Assurance-Aktivitäten, Governance-Prozessen und Management-Reporting.

Du gehörst hierher.

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten an einem der nachhaltigsten Arbeitsplätze der Welt. Auf dem Quai Zürich Campus genießen Sie eine Umgebung, die Ihnen helfen soll, zu gedeihen, mit Vorteilen, die Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Wirkung unterstützen, und Möglichkeiten, Ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen, umgeben von Top-Talenten und unterstützenden Kollegen.

Sie haben Zugang zu gesunden Nahrungsmitteln, Fitnesseinrichtungen und hellen, kollaborativen Räumen, die Kreativität auslösen. Im Herzen von Zürich am Ufer des Zürichsees gelegen, bietet der Campus eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel, die Ihren Weg zur Arbeit vereinfachen.

Wachsen Sie mit uns durch den Zugang zu Lernressourcen, On-the-Job-Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Ermächtigung und Unterstützung. Seien Sie Teil eines Teams, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schafft.

Über uns

Zurich ist ein führender Multiline-Versicherer, der über 82 Millionen Kunden in mehr als 200 Ländern und Regionen mit mehr als 65.000 Mitarbeitern betreut.

Seit über 150 Jahren verändert Zürich die Versicherung – und bietet nicht nur Schutz, sondern auch Präventionsleistungen, die Wohlbefinden und Klimaresistenz fördern.
Geleitet von unserem Ziel, gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft zu schaffen, wollen wir eines der verantwortungsvollsten und wirkungsvollsten Unternehmen der Welt sein.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung noch heute!

Warum Zürich

Bei Zurich denken wir gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hinterfragen den Status Quo. Wir gehen optimistisch vor, indem wir uns auf das Positive konzentrieren und ständig fragen: Was kann richtig gehen?

Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit, der weiß, dass jeder Mitarbeiter einzigartig ist - das macht unser Team so großartig!
Begleiten Sie uns, während wir ständig neue Wege erkunden, um unsere Kunden und den Planeten zu schützen.

L'élaboration du profil de risque d'une entreprise d'assurance mondiale vous intéresse-t-elle? Aimez-vous transformer les connaissances complexes sur les risques en mesures pratiques qui influencent les décisions stratégiques?

En tant que gestionnaire principal des risques de P&C, vous agirez en tant que partenaire d'affaires de confiance en matière de risques pour le leadership des entreprises, fournissant une vision indépendante des risques, des défis et des conseils dans l'une des plus grandes entreprises de Zurich. En collaborant étroitement avec les principaux intervenants de l'ensemble des équipes de gestion des risques et d'affaires du groupe, vous contribuerez à améliorer significativement les pratiques de gestion des risques, à renforcer la gouvernance, à promouvoir la prise de décisions éclairées et à soutenir de meilleurs résultats pour nos clients.

Votre expertise nous aidera à défier et à affiner notre appétit pour les risques, à fournir des conseils indépendants sur les risques et à appuyer des initiatives clés dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de P et C. En collaboration avec les principaux intervenants, vous aurez le pouvoir d'influencer les décisions, d'améliorer les cadres de risque et de contribuer à une organisation plus forte et plus résiliente. À Zurich, nous tenons à vous permettre de grandir – vous serez encouragé à développer vos compétences, à partager vos idées et à jouer un rôle clé dans l'élaboration de notre avenir.

Ce que vous ferez

• Fournir des conseils, des conseils et des défis indépendants en matière de risques aux intervenants clés sur les principales activités, les projets et les décisions opérationnelles dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de P et C.

• Diriger et superviser les analyses et les évaluations des risques, y compris les plongées profondes de risque et les évaluations des risques pour les grands projets; examiner et remettre en question les réponses aux risques; fournir des renseignements concrets sur les risques à la haute direction.

• Élaborer et améliorer la gouvernance des risques, y compris les politiques, les méthodes, les outils et les modèles, en veillant à ce que l'organisation de P&C soit régulièrement adoptée.

• Superviser les activités d'assurance, de surveillance et de rapport, valider les principales constatations et les traduire en idées claires pour la haute direction.

• Appuyer le leadership en matière de gestion des risques sur les priorités stratégiques, les discussions avec les cadres supérieurs et les principales questions liées aux risques.

• Promouvoir une solide culture du risque grâce à la formation et à l'engagement des intervenants.

Ce que vous apportez

• 12+ ans d'expérience en assurance commerciale ou en vente au détail, de préférence dans une fonction commerciale comme la souscription ou les réclamations, ou dans la gestion des risques.

• Diplôme ou équivalent en gestion des risques, assurance, science actuarielle, finance, économie, administration des affaires ou discipline connexe. La certification d'un souscripteur professionnel est un avantage.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'activité d'assurance P&C, y compris les principaux facteurs de risque liés à la souscription, à la réservation, aux réclamations, à la tarification, à l'exposition aux catastrophes, à la réassurance, au risque opérationnel et au risque stratégique.

• Expérience de travail dans une fonction de gestion des risques de deuxième ligne, ou expérience équivalente offrant un examen indépendant, un défi et un soutien consultatif aux intervenants commerciaux.

• Capacité éprouvée d'interpréter l'information sur les risques, d'identifier les thèmes clés et de traduire les constatations en recommandations claires et en mesures de gestion.

• Excellente capacité de communication, de pensée critique, de collaboration et d'exécution, avec des antécédents d'engagement auprès des intervenants supérieurs et d'influence sur la prise de décisions dans une organisation matricielle complexe.

• Expérience en matière d'évaluation des risques, d'examen de l'appétit pour les risques, d'activités d'assurance, de processus de gouvernance et de rapports de gestion.

Tu es ici.

Au campus Quai Zurich , vous profiterez d'un environnement conçu pour vous aider à prospérer, avec des avantages qui soutiennent votre bien-être et votre impact, et des occasions de se produire à votre meilleur, entouré de talents et de collègues de soutien.

Situé au cœur de Zurich sur les rives du lac de Zurich, le campus offre d'excellentes liaisons de transport en commun, ce qui facilite votre trajet.

Développez avec nous grâce à l'accès aux ressources d'apprentissage, au développement en cours d'emploi et à l'autonomisation et au soutien continus. Faites partie d'une équipe qui crée ensemble un avenir meilleur.

Depuis plus de 150 ans, Zurich transforme l'assurance en offrant non seulement une protection, mais aussi des services de prévention qui favorisent le bien-être et la résilience climatique.
Guidée par notre objectif de « créer ensemble un avenir meilleur », nous visons à être l'une des entreprises les plus responsables et les plus influentes du monde.

Du möchtest Menschen in herausfordernden Lebenssituationen begleiten und sie mit Fachwissen und Empathie unterstützen?

In dieser Rolle verstärkst du bei Zurich Schweiz den Geschäftsbereich Claims im Bereich Leistungen Arbeitsunfähigkeit bei Leistungen Kollektivleben Invalidität & Rückdeckung. Dabei bringst du deine Fähigkeiten ein, um herausfordernde Leistungsfälle eigenverantwortlich zu beurteilen. Du bist die Anlaufstelle für interne und externe Partner und entwickelst Prozesse laufend weiter. Mit deinem vernetzen Denken erkennst du Zusammenhänge und findest Lösungen, damit Leistungsfälle fair, effizient und kundenorientiert bearbeitet werden.

Das erwartet dich

• Du prüfst und beurteilst Leistungsansprüche in Arbeitsunfähigkeitsfällen anhand der reglementarischen Grundlagen.

• Du holst medizinische Unterlagen, Vollmachten und Versicherungsakten ein, beurteilst medizinische Sachverhalte und leitest die notwendigen Schritte im Leistungsprozess ein.

• Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Sozial- und Privatversicherer sowie weiteren internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen und prüfst den Bedarf an Case-Management-Massnahmen.

• Du steuerst deine Leistungsfälle aktiv über den gesamten Prozess, legst Revisionen und Wiedervorlagen fest und stellst deren fristgerechte Bearbeitung sicher.

• Du berätst Versicherte, Arbeitgeber sowie interne und externe Partner telefonisch und schriftlich und stellst eine kundenorientierte, transparente und termingerechte Fallbearbeitung sicher.

Das zeichnet dich aus

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Versicherungswesen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation mit Schwerpunkt berufliche Vorsorge.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung von Schadensfällen, idealerweise im Bereich BVG.

• Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.

• Fähigkeit, Prozesse effizient umzusetzen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, aktiv zur Zusammenarbeit und zum Erfolg des Teams beizutragen.

Gut zu wissen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich

Stellenantritt: ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Reisetätigkeit: keine

Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

Du kannst dich in einem ersten Schritt direkt online bei uns bewerben – dafür benötigst du nur deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier .

Approfondite le vostre competenze nelle pensioni professionali e assumetevi la responsabilità di casi di prestazioni complesse – in un team motivato che vive la cooperazione, l'orientamento del cliente e il miglioramento continuo del processo.

Sei motivato dall'idea che i clienti ricevano i loro servizi pensionistici professionali in modo efficiente e affidabile? Hai sempre voluto lavorare in un ambiente in cui si valutano casi di prestazioni complessi sulla propria responsabilità e processi di forma attivamente?

In questo ruolo, a Zurigo in Svizzera, rafforzerai la divisione di danni per Claims Corporate Customers Collection Foundation e parteciperai al team Standard Services. Si lavora in un team con otto colleghi motivati, portare la vostra esperienza nel trattamento dei casi di prestazioni e svilupparlo continuamente. Potrai perfezionare l'implementazione dei processi e aiutare i nostri clienti a fare affidamento su una gestione professionale e affidabile delle loro esigenze.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Controllare e valutare le prestazioni in caso di incapacità al lavoro in base alle normative.

• Si ottiene documenti medici, poteri di procura e registri di assicurazione, valutare i problemi medici e avviare i passaggi necessari nel processo di prestazione.

• Coordinate la cooperazione con gli assicuratori sociali e privati e con altri stakeholder interni ed esterni ed esaminate la necessità di misure di gestione dei casi.

• Controllate attivamente i vostri casi di prestazioni durante tutto il processo, determinate le revisioni e le resmissioni e assicurate la loro elaborazione tempestiva.

• Si consiglia di persone assicurate, datori di lavoro e partner interni ed esterni per telefono e per iscritto e di garantire la gestione dei casi orientata al cliente, trasparente e tempestiva.

Questo ti fa a pezzi

• Formazione assicurativa completata o qualifica equivalente con un focus sulla previdenza professionale.

• Diversi anni di esperienza nel trattamento dei casi di danno, idealmente nella zona di BVG.

• Forte orientamento del cliente e forza di comunicazione per trasmettere problemi complessi in modo comprensibile.

• Capacità di implementare processi in modo efficiente e continuo migliorarli.

• Spirito di squadra e la volontà di contribuire attivamente alla collaborazione e al successo del team.

Buono a sapersi

Tempo parziale o a tempo pieno: 80 - 100%

Luogo di lavoro: Oerlikon, Zurigo

Lavoro: d'ora in poi o d'accordo

Attività di viaggio: nessuna

Lavoro ibrido: fino al 40%

Tutto sulla tua applicazione

È possibile applicare direttamente a noi online in un primo passo – hai solo bisogno del tuo CV. Ulteriori informazioni sul processo di applicazione possono essere trovate qui.

Noi attribuiamo importanza ad un processo di applicazione efficiente e apprezzabile. Il Talent Acquisition Team esaminerà personalmente la tua applicazione senza utilizzare l'intelligenza artificiale. Dal tuo primo incontro personale con il responsabile, riceverai sempre un feedback individuale da parte nostra. Perché siamo convinti: un feedback significativo si basa sullo scambio personale.

Per questa posizione, non lavoriamo con agenzie di reclutamento. Le domande non richieste non sono considerate o remunerate.

Hai delle domande? Silke, Talent Acquisition Consultant è a vostra disposizione su +41 44 628 20 59.

137095 | 80 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zurich | Hybrid

You deepen your expertise in occupational pensions and take responsibility for complex performance cases – in a motivated team that lives cooperation, customer orientation and continuous process improvement.

Are you motivated by the idea that customers receive their professional pension services efficiently and reliably? Have you always wanted to work in an environment where you assess complex performance cases on your own responsibility and actively shape processes?

In this role, at Zurich Switzerland, you will strengthen the Claims Life damage division for Claims Corporate Customers Collection Foundation and will be part of the Standard Services team. You work in a team with eight motivated colleagues, bring your expertise in the processing of performance cases and develop it continuously. You will perfect the implementation of processes and help our customers to rely on a professional and reliable handling of their requirements.

This is what awaits you

• You check and assess benefits claims in cases of incapacity for work on the basis of the regulations.

• You obtain medical records, powers of attorney and insurance records, assess medical issues and initiate the necessary steps in the performance process.

• You coordinate the cooperation with social and private insurers as well as other internal and external stakeholders and examine the need for case management measures.

• You actively control your performance cases throughout the entire process, determine revisions and resubmissions and ensure their timely processing.

• You advise insured persons, employers and internal and external partners by telephone and in writing and ensure customer-oriented, transparent and timely case handling.

This sets you apart

• Completed insurance training or equivalent qualification with a focus on occupational pension provision.

• Several years of experience in the processing of damage cases, ideally in the area of BVG.

• Strong customer orientation and communication strength to convey complex issues in an understandable way.

• Ability to implement processes efficiently and continuously improve them.

• Team spirit and the willingness to actively contribute to the collaboration and success of the team.

Good to know

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Oerlikon, Zurich

Job: from now on or by agreement

Travel activity: none

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Everything about your application

You can apply directly to us online in a first step – you only need your CV. More information about the application process can be found here.

We attach importance to an efficient and appreciative application process. The Talent Acquisition Team will personally review your application without using artificial intelligence. From your first personal meeting with the responsible manager, you will always receive individual feedback from us. Because we are convinced: meaningful feedback is based on personal exchange.

For this position, we do not work with recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications shall not be considered or remunerated.

Do you have any questions? Silke, Talent Acquisition Consultant is at your disposal on +41 44 628 20 59.

jobs.description:
Ceded Reinsurance Manager (100%)

Does shaping complex global reinsurance programs and partnering with senior stakeholders across the Group motivate you? As a Ceded Reinsurance Manager, you will take end‑to‑end ownership of highly complex ceded reinsurance treaties and help us deliver robust, innovative risk transfer solutions for Zurich globally.

In this role, you will make a visible contribution by building strong relationships with our reinsurers and internal Business Units, while working in collaborative environment where your expertise is trusted and your ideas are valued. Guided by our values of reliability and forward‑thinking, you will be empowered to challenge the status quo, drive high‑quality outcomes and grow your career in a truly international, results‑oriented setting.

What you will do

• Positioned as a business partner, develop, and align treaty reinsurance strategies, in conjunction with key stakeholders, to support our business strategy and plan. This includes treaty structural optimization and defining scope of cover.

• Structure and negotiate highly complex ceded reinsurance treaties within your delegated underwriting authority.

• Design scope of cover, determine and refine contract wordings, and lead the end‑to‑end placement process with approved reinsurers.

• Coordinate and review exposure information and data submissions to ensure suitability for internal and external treaty pricing.

• Support reinsurance planning, treaty compliance and governance in line with Zurich Risk Policy and Group Reinsurance standards.

• Build, manage and strengthen relationships with reinsurers, brokers and key internal stakeholders, acting as a trusted expert and advisor.

What you bring

• Ability to build strong business partnering relationships within Zurich.

• Experience working across business units/functions and collaboration in a team environment.

• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in reinsurance, underwriting, or as a broker.

• Strong understanding of reinsurance contracts , and pricing concepts, with the ability to interpret and apply governance and risk policies.

• Proven track record of collaborating with diverse stakeholders, both internal and external, (e.g. reinsurers, brokers, Business Units) and influencing decisions in an international environment.

• Excellent analytical and data skills, including the ability to review exposure information, support pricing and ensure data quality for decision‑making.Strong communication skills in English (both written and spoken).

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

• Location(s): CH - Zürich

• Remote working: No

• Schedule: Full Time

• Recruiter name: Natalia Dzieglo

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ceded Reinsurance Manager (100%)

La formazione di complessi programmi di riassicurazione globale e la collaborazione con gli stakeholder senior di tutto il Gruppo ti motiva? In qualità di Ceded Reinsurance Manager, avrai la proprietà end-to-end di trattati di riassicurazione ceduti altamente complessi e ci aiuteranno a fornire soluzioni di trasferimento di rischio robuste e innovative per Zurigo a livello globale.

In questo ruolo, potrete dare un contributo visibile costruendo forti relazioni con i nostri reassicuratori e business unit interni, lavorando in un ambiente collaborativo dove la vostra esperienza è attendibile e le vostre idee sono valutate. Guidati dai nostri valori di affidabilità e pensiero in avanti, sarai in grado di sfidare lo status quo, guidare risultati di alta qualità e crescere la tua carriera in un ambiente veramente internazionale, orientato ai risultati.

Cosa farai

• Posizionato come partner commerciale, sviluppare e allineare le strategie di riassicurazione dei trattati, in concomitanza con i principali stakeholder, per sostenere la nostra strategia aziendale e il nostro piano. Ciò include l'ottimizzazione strutturale del trattato e la definizione della portata della copertura.

• Struttura e negoziare trattati di riassicurazione altamente complessi all'interno della vostra autorità di sottoscrizione delegato.

• Scopo di progettazione di copertura, determinare e perfezionare i termini contrattuali, e condurre il processo di posizionamento end-to-end con riassicuratori approvati.

• Coordinare e rivedere le informazioni sull'esposizione e le richieste di dati per garantire l'idoneità per i prezzi dei trattati interni ed esterni.

• Sostenere la pianificazione della riassicurazione, la conformità dei trattati e la governance in linea con gli standard della politica di rischio di Zurigo e della riassicurazione di gruppo.

• Costruire, gestire e rafforzare le relazioni con i reassicuratori, i broker e i principali stakeholder interni, agendo come esperto e consulente di fiducia.

Cosa porti

• Capacità di costruire forti relazioni di business partner all'interno di Zurigo.

• Esperienza di lavoro in unità aziendali/funzioni e collaborazione in un ambiente di team.

• Minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nella riassicurazione, sottoscrizione, o come broker.

• Forte comprensione dei contratti di riassicurazione e dei concetti di prezzi, con la capacità di interpretare e applicare le politiche di governance e di rischio.

• Provato record di collaborazione con diversi stakeholder, sia interni che esterni, (ad esempio reinsurer, broker, Business Units) e di influenzare le decisioni in un ambiente internazionale.

• Competenze analitiche e dati eccellenti, compresa la capacità di rivedere le informazioni sull'esposizione, sostenere i prezzi e garantire la qualità dei dati per il processo decisionale. Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (sia scritto che parlato).

Tu appartieni qui.

Immaginate di lavorare in uno dei luoghi di lavoro più sostenibili del mondo. Presso il Quai Zurich Campus, ti godrai di un ambiente progettato per aiutarti a prosperare, con benefici che supportano il tuo benessere e l'impatto, e opportunità di esibirti al meglio, circondati da grandi talenti e colleghi di supporto.

Avrete accesso a opzioni di cibo sano, strutture fitness, e spazi luminosi e collaborativi che scintillano la creatività. Situato nel cuore di Zurigo, sulle rive del Lago di Zurigo, il campus offre ottimi collegamenti con i mezzi pubblici, rendendo il vostro viaggio semplice.

Crescere con noi attraverso l'accesso alle risorse di apprendimento, lo sviluppo on-the-job, e l'empowerment continuo e il supporto. Fai parte di una squadra che sta creando un futuro più luminoso insieme.

Informazioni su di noi

Zurigo è un'azienda multi-linea leader, con oltre 82 milioni di clienti in oltre 200 paesi e territori con oltre 65.000 dipendenti.
Da oltre 150 anni, Zurigo sta trasformando l'assicurazione – offrendo non solo protezione, ma anche servizi di prevenzione che promuovono il benessere e la resilienza climatica.
Guidato dal nostro scopo di “creare un futuro più luminoso insieme”, ci proponiamo di essere una delle aziende più responsabili e d’impatto al mondo.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione online oggi!

Informazioni sulle agenzie di reclutamento

Zurigo non accetta domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Rifiutiamo qualsiasi responsabilità per le applicazioni non richieste, così come eventuali commissioni associate.

Perché Zurigo

A Zurigo, ci piace pensare al di fuori della scatola e sfidare lo status quo. Prendiamo un approccio ottimista concentrandoci sui positivi e chiedendo costantemente cosa può andare bene?

Siamo un datore di lavoro pari opportunità che sa che ogni dipendente è unico - questo è ciò che rende il nostro team così grande!
Unisciti a noi mentre esploriamo costantemente nuovi modi per proteggere i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

• Posizione(i): CH - Zürich

• Funzionamento remoto: No

• Orari: Tempo pieno

• Nome del reclutatore: Natalia Dzieglo

• Design scope of cover, determine and refine contract wordings, and lead the end‑to‑end placement process with approved reinsurers.

• Ability to build strong business partnering relationships within Zurich.

• Experience working across business units/functions and collaboration in a team environment.

• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in reinsurance, underwriting, or as a broker.

• Strong understanding of reinsurance contracts , and pricing concepts, with the ability to interpret and apply governance and risk policies.

• Proven track record of collaborating with diverse stakeholders, both internal and external, (e.g. reinsurers, brokers, Business Units) and influencing decisions in an international environment.

• Excellent analytical and data skills, including the ability to review exposure information, support pricing and ensure data quality for decision‑making.Strong communication skills in English (both written and spoken).

Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen).

Are you inspired by the idea of shaping the technological future of Zurich and setting the architectural direction for one of our most important strategic initiatives? Do you enjoy navigating complex solution landscapes and designing robust, future-proof architectures? Then this is the right place for you!

In this role, you will be part of the Information & Technology business unit within P&C Transformation and actively help shape the continued development of Zurich Switzerland.

Become part of the most important strategic P&C initiative, where future products, processes and technologies are being built. As a Solution Architect, you take on a key role in the end-to-end solution design across all Guidewire Centers (Jutro Digital Platform, PolicyCenter, BillingCenter) as well as adjacent Zurich Solutions. You ensure architectural consistency, drive sound technical decision-making, and make sure our solutions comply with Zurich's architecture standards (e.g. ASD42).

What you can expect

• Take ownership of the end-to-end solution design across all Guidewire Centers (Jutro Digital Platform, PolicyCenter, BillingCenter) and adjacent Zurich Solutions

• Ensure architectural consistency and compliance with Zurich's architecture standards (e.g. ASD42) across the entire solution stack

• Evaluate solution alternatives and make well-founded technical decisions in close collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, Security and delivery teams

• Translate complex business requirements into end-to-end solution designs and guide them from concept to successful implementation

• Act as the central point of contact for architectural topics, working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, development teams and external partners

What makes you stand out

• A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or a comparable qualification, combined with several years of experience as a Solution Architect in an agile insurance environment

• Proven, hands-on experience with Guidewire systems (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, Jutro Digital Platform, Integration Gateway) and their integration into complex IT architectures – ideally at an international insurer such as Zurich

• Solid expertise in integration architectures, API design, cloud technologies (Azure and/or AWS) and common architecture frameworks (e.g. arc42/ASD42, TOGAF)

• Strong analytical and conceptual skills, paired with a structured, decisive way of working and the ability to communicate technical topics to different audiences

• Very good command of English and/or German (C1/C2 level)

Good to know

Formare il futuro dell'assicurazione vita con noi!

Vuoi utilizzare la tua esperienza tecnica per creare soluzioni innovative per i nostri clienti? State cercando un ambiente in cui formate attivamente complesse applicazioni aziendali e la nostra strategia di digitalizzazione? Allora siete nel posto giusto con noi in IT Life Svizzera e nel programma "Digital Individual Life Insurer" (DILI).

Come IT Life of Zurich Insurance Svizzera, forniamo tutti i servizi IT specifici per l'assicurazione per la divisione Swiss Life. Come parte del programma DILI, forniamo il futuro servizio IT per gestire il nostro business di vita individuale. Per rafforzare il nostro team dedicato, ti stiamo cercando come Senior Data Solution Engineer.

In qualità di Senior Data Solutions Engineer, si svolge un ruolo chiave nella tecnologia dell'informazione e contribuisce a promuovere la strategia dei dati di Zurigo Schweiz Leben in collaborazione con il dipartimento di vita individuale. Sviluppi e mantieni entrambi i prodotti di dati curati – ovvero i set di dati chiaramente definiti e facili da usare dell'unità aziendale di vita individuale – e i prodotti di dati complessi utilizzati da altre unità aziendali. In questo modo, si utilizza e migliorare la nostra moderna piattaforma Data & Insight Generation (DIG) e lavorare in collaborazione con i vari dipartimenti per creare una migliore comprensione dei nostri clienti e delle loro esigenze.

Sei affascinato dal mondo dei dati e vuoi sviluppare soluzioni innovative che fanno una vera differenza? Se avete forti capacità di problem solving, sono comunicativi e godere di lavorare in team multidisciplinari, questo lavoro è per voi.

Scopri qui perché Zurigo Svizzera è uno dei datori di lavoro "Top 3" in Svizzera. Diventa parte di esso e applica come Senior Data Solutions Engineer.

Cosa fai

- L'utente integra i dati e lavora a stretto contatto con gli esperti IT & Business e i proprietari di prodotti provenienti da varie aree di business (compresa la vita individuale, la finanza, l'ufficio clienti, l'agente, i partenariati di broker e partnership, la sottoscrizione, la tecnologia di gruppo & operazioni)

- Progetti, sviluppi e implementa soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e flessibili con i componenti Microsoft Azure / Fabric per sviluppare ulteriormente la nostra piattaforma dati

- Sviluppare e utilizzare datadotti affidabili utilizzati per applicazioni di analisi

- Conduci controlli di qualità dei dati e promuovi un miglioramento continuo durante il ciclo di vita dei nostri prodotti dati

- Assicurarsi che le nostre linee guida sulla governance dei dati siano rispettate e siano attivamente coinvolte nell'ulteriore sviluppo del nostro standard di prodotto.

Cosa porti

- Laurea in informatica, informatica aziendale o un campo correlato e almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante

- Conoscenza approfondita delle moderne tecnologie dei dati con un focus su Microsoft Azure & Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Data Vault)

- Diversi anni di esperienza professionale lavorando con i linguaggi di programmazione del trattamento dei dati, in particolare in Python, PySpark e SQL

- Forte capacità analitiche e la capacità di risolvere problemi complessi

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese

Siamo per la giustizia e l'uguaglianza tra i nostri dipendenti, indipendentemente dal sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine, etnia, religione, ecc. L'acquisizione dei nostri talenti e dei processi di reclutamento riflettono questo impegno nella vita quotidiana. Unisciti a noi e diventare parte di questa cultura.

Shape the future of life insurance with us!

Do you want to use your technical expertise to create innovative solutions for our customers? Are you looking for an environment in which you actively shape complex business applications and our digitalization strategy? Then you are in the right place with us in IT Life Switzerland and in the program "Digital Individual Life Insurer" (DILI).

As IT Life of Zurich Insurance Switzerland, we provide all insurance-specific IT services for the Swiss Life division. As part of the DILI program, we provide the future IT service for handling our individual life business. To strengthen our dedicated team, we are looking for you as a Senior Data Solution Engineer.

As a Senior Data Solutions Engineer, you play a key role in Information Technology and contribute to advancing the data strategy of Zurich Schweiz Leben in cooperation with the individual life department. You develop and maintain both curated data products – i.e. clearly defined, easy-to-use data sets from the individual life business unit – and complex data products used by other business units. In doing so, you use and improve our modern Data & Insight Generation Platform (DIG) and work in partnership with the various departments to create a better understanding of our customers and their needs.

Are you fascinated by the world of data and do you want to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference? If you have strong problem-solving skills, are communicative and enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams, this job is for you.

Find out here why Zurich Switzerland is one of the "Top 3" employers in Switzerland. Become a part of it and apply as a Senior Data Solutions Engineer.

What you do

- You integrate data and work closely with IT & Business experts as well as product owners from various business areas (including individual life, finance, customer office, agent, broker & partnerships, underwriting, Group Technology & Operations)

- You design, develop and implement scalable, reliable and flexible solutions with Microsoft Azure / Fabric components to further develop our data platform

- Develop and operate reliable data pipelines used for analytics applications

- You conduct data quality checks and promote continuous improvement throughout the life cycle of our data products

- You ensure that our data governance guidelines are adhered to and are actively involved in the further development of our data product standard.

What you bring

- University degree in computer science, business informatics or a related field and at least 5 years of relevant professional experience

- In-depth knowledge of modern data technologies with a focus on Microsoft Azure & Data Modeling (Star Schema, Snowflake, Data Vault)

- Several years of professional experience working with data processing programming languages, especially in Python, PySpark and SQL

- Strong analytical skills and the ability to solve complex problems

- Excellent communication skills in German and English

Your contact

Talent Acquisition Consultant: Marco Stettler (+41 44 628 31 62)

Additional information

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Zurich, Oerlikon

Hybrids working: up to 40%

We look forward to your online application – even without an application letter.
You are welcome to convince us of your motivation during a personal meeting.

Who we are

Zurich is a strong brand – more than 1.4 million Swiss customers rely on our products and services. The basis of our success is our 53,000 employees worldwide, who help our customers in 210 countries and territories to better understand and protect themselves against their risks. In order to provide daily performance, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting training opportunities. As a Zurich employee, you benefit from a multitude of advantages and a strong culture characterized by acceptance, diversity and team orientation.

At Zurich, we cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our goals and values are designed to protect our employees, promote trust and help them reach their full potential. We stand for justice and equality among our employees, regardless of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, religion, etc. The acquisition of our talents and the recruitment processes reflect this commitment in everyday life. Join us and become part of this culture.

Why has Zurich been successful for more than 150 years? See here and become part of it.

Zurich does not accept unsolicited applications from recruiters for this position. Therefore, recruiters do not submit applicant documents to our employees or via our online career portal. We reject any responsibility for unsolicited applications and any fees and thank you for your understanding.

Begeistert dich ein dynamisches Umfeld, in dem du Prioritäten setzt, Menschen weiterentwickelst und Veränderungen aktiv mitgestaltest?

Du führst ein Team von rund 12 Schadenspezialistinnen und Schadenspezialisten im Bereich UVG/UVGZ und förderst deine Mitarbeitenden fachlich und persönlich. Gemeinsam mit den Fachverantwortlichen und dem Führungsteam der Region Deutschschweiz entwickelst du die Zusammenarbeit und Arbeitsweise weiter und stellst eine kundenorientierte und effiziente Leistungserbringung sicher.

Das erwartet dich

• Du führst ein Team von rund 12 Schadenspezialistinnen und Schadenspezialisten im Bereich UVG/UVGZ und förderst deren fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

• Du verantwortest den Personalprozess von der Rekrutierung und dem Onboarding bis zu Beurteilungs- und Entwicklungsgesprächen.

• Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachverantwortlichen deines Teams und dem Führungsteam der Region Deutschschweiz zusammen.

• Du pflegst den Austausch mit internen und externen Partnerinnen und Partnern und entwickelst gemeinsam passende Lösungen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden.

• Du entwickelst deinen Bereich kontinuierlich weiter und gestaltest Veränderungen und Innovationen aktiv mit.

Das zeichnet dich aus

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche und fundierte Erfahrung in der Schadenabwicklung im Bereich Unfall.

• Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden oder nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer vergleichbaren fachlichen Führungsrolle.

• Verständnis für technische und digitale Weiterentwicklungen sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit IT-Themen.

• Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie klare und wertschätzende Kommunikation.

• Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen Prioritäten zu setzen.

Sei motivato dall'idea di guidare un team di clienti nel settore degli incidenti, dando orientamento e assicurando l'elaborazione di reclami professionali insieme ai tuoi dipendenti? Sei entusiasta di un ambiente dinamico in cui hai impostato le priorità, sviluppare le persone e modellare attivamente il cambiamento?

In qualità di Responsabile Gruppo del Team Clienti Incidenti, rafforzerete la business unit di Zurigo in Svizzera nel settore dei servizi di assicurazione personale presso il sito Kriens e dare un importante contributo al nostro successo congiunto. Conduci un team di circa 12 specialisti dei danni nell'area di UVG/UVGZ e supporta i tuoi dipendenti professionalmente e personalmente. Insieme agli specialisti e al team di gestione della Svizzera tedesca, continuerete a sviluppare la cooperazione e i metodi di lavoro e a garantire la fornitura di servizi orientati al cliente ed efficiente.

Questo è ciò che vi aspetta

• Conduci un team di circa 12 specialisti dei danni nel campo di UVG/UVGZ e promuovi il loro sviluppo professionale e personale.

• Sei responsabile del processo del personale dal reclutamento e dall'imbarco alle discussioni di valutazione e sviluppo.

• Lavorate a stretto contatto con gli specialisti del vostro team e con il team di gestione della Svizzera tedesca.

• Si manterrà uno scambio con partner interni ed esterni e svilupperà congiuntamente soluzioni adatte ai nostri clienti.

• Sviluppi continuamente la tua area e modella attivamente i cambiamenti e le innovazioni.

Questo ti fa a pezzi

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel settore assicurativo e esperienza approfondita nella gestione dei crediti nel settore degli infortuni.

• Esperienza nella gestione e nello sviluppo dei dipendenti o esperienza dimostrabile in un ruolo di leadership professionale paragonabile.

• Una comprensione degli sviluppi tecnici e digitali e una gestione sicura degli argomenti IT.

• Forte orientamento al cliente e al servizio, nonché comunicazione chiara e apprezzata.

• Metodo di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e orientato alla soluzione con la capacità di fissare priorità anche in situazioni difficili.

Are you motivated by the idea of leading a customer team in the area of accidents, giving orientation and ensuring professional claims processing together with your employees? Are you excited about a dynamic environment in which you set priorities, develop people and actively shape change?

As Group Head of the Accident Customer Team, you will strengthen Zurich Switzerland’s Claims business unit in the area of personal insurance services at the Kriens site and make an important contribution to our joint success. You lead a team of around 12 damage specialists in the area of UVG/UVGZ and support your employees professionally and personally. Together with the specialists and the management team of the German-speaking Switzerland region, you will continue to develop the cooperation and working methods and ensure customer-oriented and efficient service provision.

This is what awaits you

• You lead a team of around 12 damage specialists in the field of UVG/UVGZ and promote their professional and personal development.

• You are responsible for the personnel process from recruitment and onboarding to assessment and development discussions.

• You work closely with the specialists of your team and the management team of the German-speaking Switzerland region.

• You will maintain an exchange with internal and external partners and jointly develop suitable solutions for our customers.

• You continuously develop your area and actively shape changes and innovations.

This sets you apart

• Several years of professional experience in the insurance industry and in-depth experience in claims handling in the area of accidents.

• Experience in the management and development of employees or demonstrable experience in a comparable professional leadership role.

• An understanding of technical and digital developments as well as a secure handling of IT topics.

• Strong customer and service orientation as well as clear and appreciative communication.

• Structured, independent and solution-oriented working method with the ability to set priorities even in demanding situations.

Good to know

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Kriens, Lucerne

Travel activity: None

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Everything about your application

You can apply directly to us online in a first step – you only need your CV. More information about the application process can be found here.

We attach importance to an efficient and appreciative application process. The Talent Acquisition Team will personally review your application without using artificial intelligence. From your first personal meeting with the responsible manager, you will always receive individual feedback from us. Because we are convinced: meaningful feedback is based on personal exchange.

For this position, we do not work with recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications shall not be considered or remunerated.

Do you have any questions? Bernd, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant is at your disposal on +41 44 628 42 14.

Are you energized by solving complex IT challenges, and do you bring the emotional intelligence to navigate stakeholders across business, security, and engineering? Do you question the status quo and use your judgment to shape direction where best practice does not yet exist?

In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI-augmented enterprise.

We’re looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future-ready, cost-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves - in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.

You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.

We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.

If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.

What you can expect

• Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey

• Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event-driven and AI-augmented workflows

• Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust

• Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI-augmented workflows - ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer

• Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes

What makes you stand out

• 7 + years in software or security engineering - ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry - with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands-on Keycloak experience

• Hands-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent-to-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI-augmented development (Copilot, Claude, agentic workflows)

• Solid understanding of fine-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)

• Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written, German is a plus

Good to know

Start date: by agreement

Travel: No travel required

Hybrid working: up to 40%

Everything about your application

As a first step, you can apply directly online. All you need is your CV. You can find further information about the application process here .

We are committed to an efficient and respectful application process. Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application personally, without the use of artificial intelligence. After your first personal meeting with the responsible hiring manager, you will always receive individual feedback from us, because we believe meaningful feedback is based on personal dialogue.

For this position, we do not work with recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications will neither be considered nor compensated.

Sei eccitato risolvendo complesse sfide informatiche, e porti l'intelligenza emotiva a navigare le parti interessate attraverso il business, la sicurezza e l'ingegneria? Interrogate lo status quo e usate il vostro giudizio per modellare la direzione in cui la migliore pratica non esiste ancora?

Nel team di Ingegneria e Integrazione, colleghiamo ciò che è separato, assicuriamo ciò che conta, e riveliamo ciò che è nascosto, plasmando come l'integrazione, l'identità e la sicurezza lavorano in un mondo di AI Agentic, consegna ibrida e Zero Trust. Stiamo modernizzando la nostra piattaforma di identità intorno a Keycloak, incorporando Zero Trust e l'autorizzazione fine-grained come il default, e la costruzione delle basi di identità per un'impresa potenziata dall'IA.

Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista esperto che conduce attraverso concetti, direzione e giudizio, preparando la Svizzera di Zurigo per quello che è prossimo, assicurando un futuro-ready, economico paesaggio di applicazione che scala come il nostro business evolve - in un'epoca in cui il valore ingegneristico sempre più sta nel giudizio.

Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il nostro Senior Product Owner/Architetto, Ingegneri e Specialisti, come la persona che muove le cose in avanti, tecnologicamente, metodologicamente e concettuale.

Siamo un team agile e collaborativo con una forte rete in Business Unit Svizzera. Insieme a tutti i dipartimenti IT, uniamo competenze tecniche profonde con una chiara attenzione alla consegna e un servizio eccezionale ai nostri stakeholder.

Se amate risolvere problemi duri, comunicare con chiarezza ed empatia, e prosperare in team multidisciplinari, questo ruolo è esattamente giusto per voi.

Cosa ci si può aspettare

• Impostare la direzione tecnica per come il nostro team ingegneri identità e sicurezza in un'epoca in cui la codifica si sposta verso diventare una merce, attraverso concetti, principi e architetture di riferimento che altri nel team e oltre costruiranno e porterà il team in quel viaggio

• Formare l'evoluzione e le operazioni della nostra piattaforma Enterprise Identity (centro strategico: Keycloak), tra cui OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML e PKCE, mentre guida la fase della nostra federazione legacy e estende la nostra postura di sicurezza in flussi di lavoro orientati agli eventi e potenziati dall'IA

• Sviluppare e articolare l'immagine di destinazione per l'identità e la sicurezza nell'era dell'Agenteic AI, dai concetti di gestione dell'accesso e sicurezza per gli agenti dell'AI, i flussi di lavoro agentici e l'identità del carico di lavoro, all'autorizzazione fine-grained (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) e Zero Trust

• Impostare standard di ingegneria, recensioni e porte di qualità in team interni, partner e flussi di lavoro potenziati dall'IA - garantire qualità, sicurezza e trasferimento di conoscenze

• Partner con domini aziendali e Prodotti Digitali per tradurre i requisiti assicurativi in risultati di identità e sicurezza robusti

Cosa ti fa stare in piedi

• 7 + anni di ingegneria del software o della sicurezza - idealmente in assicurazioni, banche o un settore dei servizi finanziari correlati - con profonda esperienza nell'autenticazione moderna (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, ciclo di vita di token, federazione, LDAP) e esperienza di keycloak hands-on

• Esperienza pratica con i concetti di gestione dell'accesso dell'intelligenza artificiale e di sicurezza (identità di età, agente-a-agente a-agente auth, sicurezza MCP, pronta difesa dell'iniezione, sicurezza della supply chain per i componenti dell'IA) e un occhio critico per i limiti di sviluppo aumentata dell'IA (Copilota, Claude, flussi di lavoro agentici)

• Solida comprensione dell'autorizzazione in granito (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust e cloud-native engineering (Azure e/o AWS, container, streaming eventi)

• Forte senso di proprietà E2E, curiosità aziendale, capacità di tradurre l'intento di business in specifiche tecniche, pensiero critico e riflessione, e la capacità di applicare principi, rischi di nome, trade-off di superficie e gestire l'ambiguità, abbinato a forti capacità di comunicazione che guadagnano fiducia e portare ingegneri senior lungo

Are you energized by solving complex IT challenges, and do you bring the emotional intelligence to navigate stakeholders across business, security, and engineering? Do you question the status quo and use your judgment to shape direction where best practice does not yet exist?

In the Engineering and Integration team, we connect what's separated, secure what matters, and reveal what's hidden, while shaping how integration, identity, and security work in a world of Agentic AI, hybrid delivery, and Zero Trust. We're modernising our identity platform around Keycloak, embedding Zero Trust and fine-grained authorization as the default, and building the identity foundations for an AI-augmented enterprise.

We’re looking for an experienced professional who leads through concepts, direction, and judgment, preparing Zurich Switzerland for what's next, by ensuring a future-ready, cost-efficient application landscape that scales as our business evolves - in an era where engineering value increasingly lies in judgment.

You'll work closely with our Senior Product Owner/Architect, Engineers, and Specialists, as the person who moves things forward, technologically, methodologically and conceptually.

We're an agile, collaborative team with a strong network across Business Unit Switzerland. Together with all IT departments, we combine deep technical expertise with a clear focus on delivery and outstanding service to our stakeholders.

If you love solving hard problems, communicate with clarity and empathy, and thrive in multidisciplinary teams, this role is exactly right for you.

What you can expect

• Set the technical direction for how our team engineers identity and security in an era where coding shifts toward becoming a commodity, through concepts, principles, and reference architectures that others in the team and beyond will build on and bring the team along on that journey

• Shape the evolution and operations of our Enterprise Identity Platform (strategic focus: Keycloak), including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and PKCE, while steering the phase out of our legacy federation and extend our security posture into event-driven and AI-augmented workflows

• Develop and articulate the target picture for identity and security in the age of Agentic AI, from access management and security concepts for AI agents, agentic workflows, and workload identity, to fine-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar) and Zero Trust

• Set engineering standards, reviews, and quality gates across internal teams, partners, and AI-augmented workflows - ensuring quality, security, and knowledge transfer

• Partner with business domains and Digital Products to translate insurance requirements into robust identity and security outcomes

What makes you stand out

• 7 + years in software or security engineering - ideally in insurance, banking, or a related financial services industry - with deep expertise in modern authentication (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, PKCE, token lifecycle, federation, LDAP) and hands-on Keycloak experience

• Hands-on experience with Agentic AI access management and security concepts (agent identity, agent-to-agent auth, MCP security, prompt injection defense, supply chain security for AI components) and a critical eye for the limitations of AI-augmented development (Copilot, Claude, agentic workflows)

• Solid understanding of fine-grained authorization (OpenFGA, OPA, Cedar), Zero Trust, and cloud-native engineering (Azure and/or AWS, containers, event streaming)

• Strong sense of E2E ownership, business curiosity, ability to translate business intent into technical specifications, critical thinking and reflection, and ability to apply principles, name risks, surface trade-offs and manage ambiguity, paired with strong communication skills that earn trust and bring senior engineers along

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written, German is a plus

Good to know

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Work location : Oerlikon, Zurich

Start date: by agreement

Travel: No travel required

Hybrid working: up to 40%

Everything about your application

As a first step, you can apply directly online. All you need is your CV. You can find further information about the application process here .

We are committed to an efficient and respectful application process. Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application personally, without the use of artificial intelligence. After your first personal meeting with the responsible hiring manager, you will always receive individual feedback from us, because we believe meaningful feedback is based on personal dialogue.

For this position, we do not work with recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications will neither be considered nor compensated.

Do you have any questions? Marco, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant will be happy to assist you on +41 44 628 31 62 .

jobs.description:
Join our team at the Group’s Corporate Center Legal team and help enable Zurich’s success by providing strategic legal support across IT, business operations and strategic sourcing. In this role, you will advise on complex legal matters, collaborate closely with Zurich’s industry-leading teams and set the strategic direction for your team. This is an exciting opportunity to grow, innovate and make an impact as part of a passionate team.

What you will do

• Serve as a strategic legal counterpart to the procurement organization, help shape sourcing strategy, constructively challenge established approaches.

• Provide strategic, pragmatic and actionable legal advice on complex IT and business operations matters, including operational resilience and cybersecurity.

• Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex sourcing arrangements, including major international contracts for IT infrastructure, cloud and AI services, IT outsourcing and regulated outsourcing.

• Maintain and continuously improve templates and intra-group agreements.

• Constantly identify and implement opportunities to make governance processes and related frameworks effective, proportionate and supportive of responsible business execution.

• Build trusted relationships across Zurich’s businesses and functions globally, and use your influence to shape key decisions, strategic projects and business initiatives.

• Define and deliver the strategic direction for Legal IT & Business Operations, aligned with Zurich’s business priorities, risk appetite and broader legal strategy.

• Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing team by setting clear priorities and fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous professional growth.

• Advance a legal operating model that uses technology to deliver efficient, scalable and commercially focused legal services.

• Manage relationships with external legal counsel and engage constructively with relevant regulatory authorities.

What you bring

• A proactive, hands-on, curious and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to think creatively and navigate complex issues.

• Extensive expertise and a strong track record in sourcing and negotiations, particularly in IT services and ideally gained at an international insurance company, leading law firm or global organization.

• Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set direction, build capability and create an inclusive, high-performing team culture.

• Strong strategic judgment and commercial acumen, with the ability to evaluate complex legal and regulatory issues and translate them into practical legal advice for business stakeholders.

• Credibility and confidence to advise, challenge and influence senior executives and stakeholders across businesses, functions and geographies.

• A law degree and bar exam, preferably from Switzerland.

• Postgraduate studies, such as an LL.M., and other relevant qualifications are advantageous.

• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in additional languages is desirable.

You belong here.

Imagine working in one of the world’s most sustainable workplaces. At Quai Zurich Campus , you’ll enjoy an environment designed to help you thrive, with benefits that support your well-being and impact, and opportunities to perform at your best, surrounded by top talent and supportive colleagues.

You’ll have access to healthy food options, fitness facilities, and bright, collaborative spaces that spark creativity. Located in the heart of Zurich on the shores of Lake Zurich, the campus offers excellent public transportation links, making your commute simple.

Grow with us through access to learning resources, on-the-job development, and continuous empowerment and support. Be part of a team that is creating a brighter future together.

About Us

Zurich is a leading multi-line insurer, serving over 82 million customers in more than 200 countries and territories with more than 65,000 employees.
For over 150 years, Zurich has been transforming insurance – offering not just protection, but also prevention services that promote well-being and climate resilience.
Guided by our purpose to ‘create a brighter future together,’ we aim to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world.

We look forward to receiving your online application today!

Information for recruitment agencies

Zurich does not accept any applications from recruitment agencies for this position. We refuse any responsibility for unsolicited applications, as well as any associated fees.

Why Zurich

At Zurich, we like to think outside the box and challenge the status quo. We take an optimistic approach by focusing on the positives and constantly asking What can go right?

We are an equal opportunity employer who knows that each employee is unique - that’s what makes our team so great!
Join us as we constantly explore new ways to protect our customers and the planet .

Does the demanding legal assessment and self-responsible management of complex physical injury cases motivate you? Do you want to use your expertise in liability and insurance law to develop fair and sustainable solutions together with different stakeholders?

In this role, at Zurich Switzerland, you will strengthen the Claims business unit in the field of motor vehicle damage and will be part of the Team Physical Injury. You are responsible for the holistic handling of complex personal injury cases with a focus on motor vehicle liability and assess demanding questions regarding coverage, liability and the amount of damage. You conduct negotiations with insured persons, injured persons, legal representatives and other insurance companies and coordinate your cases with the relevant internal and external partners.

This is what awaits you

• You control complex bodily damage cases holistically and assess facts with regard to coverage, liability and damage amount

• You review and evaluate claims and develop viable solutions based on your legal and professional assessment

• You conduct challenging negotiations with the insured, injured persons, legal representatives and insurance companies

• You coordinate your cases with social and private insurance as well as other internal and external specialists

• You assess recourse options and ensure their consistent processing and enforcement

This sets you apart

• You have a lawyer’s patent or a law degree from a Swiss university.

• You bring in-depth knowledge of liability and insurance law as well as relevant experience in the processing of personal injury.

• You analyze complex issues in a structured manner and have a strong legal judgement.

• You communicate convincingly and appreciatively and also lead solution-oriented negotiations in demanding situations.

• You have very good knowledge of German in word and writing.

Good to know

Part-time or full-time: 80 - 100%

Place of work: Oerlikon, Zurich

Job: from 01.01.2027 or by agreement

Travel activity: rarely

Hybrid work: up to 40%

Everything about your application

You can apply directly to us online in a first step – you only need your CV. More information about the application process can be found here.

We value an efficient and appreciative application process. The Talent Acquisition Team will personally review your application without using artificial intelligence. From your first personal meeting with the responsible manager, you will always receive individual feedback from us. Because we are convinced: meaningful feedback is based on personal exchange.

For this position, we do not cooperate with recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications shall not be considered or paid.

Do you have any questions? Bernd, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant is at your disposal on +41 44 628 42 14.

Motiviert dich die anspruchsvolle juristische Beurteilung und eigenverantwortliche Steuerung komplexer Körperschadenfälle? Möchtest du deine Expertise im Haftpflicht- und Versicherungsrecht einsetzen, um gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen faire und tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln?

In dieser Rolle verstärkst du bei Zurich Schweiz den Geschäftsbereich Claims im Bereich Schaden Motorfahrzeuge und bist Teil des Teams Körperschaden. Du verantwortest die ganzheitliche Bearbeitung komplexer Körperschadenfälle mit Schwerpunkt Motorfahrzeug-Haftpflicht und beurteilst anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen zu Deckung, Haftung und Schadenhöhe. Dabei führst du Verhandlungen mit Versicherten, geschädigten Personen, Rechtsvertretungen und weiteren Versicherungen und koordinierst deine Fälle mit den relevanten internen und externen Partnerinnen und Partnern.

Das erwartet dich

• Du steuerst komplexe Körperschadenfälle ganzheitlich und beurteilst Sachverhalte hinsichtlich Deckung, Haftung und Schadenhöhe

• Du prüfst und bewertest Ansprüche und entwickelst auf Basis deiner rechtlichen und fachlichen Beurteilung tragfähige Lösungen

• Du führst anspruchsvolle Verhandlungen mit Versicherten, geschädigten Personen, Rechtsvertretungen und Versicherungsunternehmen

• Du koordinierst deine Fälle mit Sozial- und Privatversicherungen sowie weiteren internen und externen Fachstellen

• Du beurteilst Regressmöglichkeiten und stellst deren konsequente Bearbeitung und Durchsetzung sicher

Das zeichnet dich aus

• Du verfügst über ein Rechtsanwaltspatent oder einen juristischen Hochschulabschluss einer Schweizer Universität.

• Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse im Haftpflicht- und Versicherungsrecht sowie relevante Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung von Personenschäden mit.

• Du analysierst komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert und verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes rechtliches Urteilsvermögen.

• Du kommunizierst überzeugend und wertschätzend und führst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen lösungsorientierte Verhandlungen.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Gut zu wissen

Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100%

Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich

Stellenantritt: ab 01.01.2027 oder nach Vereinbarung

Reisetätigkeit: Selten

Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40%

Du kannst dich in einem ersten Schritt direkt online bei uns bewerben – dafür benötigst du nur deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier .

Est-ce que l'évaluation juridique exigeante et la gestion auto-responsable des cas complexes de blessures physiques vous motivent? Voulez-vous utiliser votre expertise en matière de responsabilité et de droit de l'assurance pour développer des solutions équitables et durables avec différents intervenants?

Dans ce rôle, à Zurich Suisse, vous renforcerez l'unité d'affaires Revendications dans le domaine des dommages causés aux véhicules à moteur et ferez partie de l'équipe de blessures physiques. Vous êtes responsable de la gestion globale des cas complexes de blessures corporelles en mettant l'accent sur la responsabilité des véhicules automobiles et en évaluant les questions exigeantes concernant la couverture, la responsabilité et le montant des dommages. Vous négociez avec les assurés, les blessés, les représentants légaux et d'autres compagnies d'assurance et coordonnez vos dossiers avec les partenaires internes et externes concernés.

C'est ce qui vous attend

• Vous contrôlez les cas complexes de dommages corporels de manière globale et évaluez les faits en ce qui concerne la couverture, la responsabilité et le montant des dommages

• Vous examinez et évaluez les réclamations et développez des solutions viables basées sur votre évaluation juridique et professionnelle

• Vous conduisez des négociations difficiles avec les assurés, les blessés, les représentants légaux et les compagnies d'assurance

• Vous coordonnez vos dossiers avec les assurances sociales et privées ainsi qu'avec d'autres spécialistes internes et externes

• Vous évaluez les options de recours et assurez leur traitement et leur application cohérents

Cela vous distingue

• Vous avez un brevet d'avocat ou un diplôme en droit d'une université suisse.

• Vous apportez une connaissance approfondie du droit de la responsabilité et de l'assurance ainsi que l'expérience pertinente dans le traitement des dommages corporels.

• Vous analysez les questions complexes de manière structurée et avez un jugement juridique fort.

• Vous communiquez de manière convaincante et reconnaissante et dirigez également des négociations orientées vers la solution dans des situations exigeantes.

• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture.
